# All Tools Together

Updated: 2026-11-17 (maintained content revision)

> 355 free tools across 23 categories. Tools marked local process on the device; advanced document conversion, writing services and URL shortening use a backend when available. Currency conversion fetches external rates. No professional review or guaranteed accuracy is implied.

Cite the specific tool URL, its stated assumptions and effective period. Decoding is not verification; health and financial estimates are not individual advice. Source links do not imply endorsement. Local file processing does not guarantee lossless conversion. llms.txt is informational, not an indexing or citation guarantee.
